payload.learning_objective: See the direct connection between a ring in the circle and its corresponding strip in the triangle — each ring becomes a horizontal strip with width equal to its circumference

mini_spec.title: Circle and Triangle Side-by-Side

mini_spec.primary_visual_feedback: Highlighted ring on left corresponds to highlighted strip on right simultaneously; the triangle shows all rings stacked with dimensions labeled
mini_spec.causal_chain_exposed: Left panel shows nested colored rings, right panel shows all strips forming triangle with base 2πR and height R labeled, highlighted ring matches highlighted strip
mini_spec.trace_strategy: Current state is sufficient — focus is on the correspondence
mini_spec.aha_moment: Each ring in the circle maps directly to a strip in the triangle — the connection is visual and immediate

payload.proposition: A thin ring, when cut and unrolled, becomes a rectangle with width 2πr (the circumference) and height dr (the thickness)
payload.narrative_draft:
Now see the magic connection. On the left is your circle, divided into rings. On the right is where those rings end up when unrolled — stacked into a triangle.

Watch what happens when you highlight a ring. The corresponding strip in the triangle lights up at the same moment. Each ring becomes a horizontal strip — its width is the circumference at that radius, 2πr.

The connection between circle and triangle is direct and visible. Every ring has its place in the triangle.

contract.student_sees: highlighted ring on left corresponds to highlighted strip on right; the triangle shows all rings stacked
